text:
samir: quick sync — from the latest postmortem (link: https://redwood.internal/postmortem/2025-09-01-redis-evictions) we saw a recurring pattern of redis evictions causing degraded latency. I want concrete runbook/playbook updates + owners/duedates. can we triage and list exact commands to run?

marta: got it. i sketched a draft in google: https://docs.google.com/d/redis-playbook-draft — suggests: immediate triage steps, metadata to capture, escalation path to infra-leads, and a followup telemetry alert.

devon: I can own the runbook PR. plan: add a short triage section + automated checks for evictions. target PR by EOD Friday (3 days).

oncall-bot: Incident #4528 created: redis-evictions — assigned to devon for runbook updates. Link: https://redwood.incidents/4528

triage-bot: Automated triage snippet that helped during the incident:
```
# quick checks 
curl -s "https://metrics.internal/api/query?query=redis_instance_evictions{env=\"prod\"}" | jq 
kubectl -n runtime get pods -l app=redis -o wide
redis-cli INFO memory | egrep 'used_memory_human|maxmemory'
```

chris: can we add a preflight: check cluster memory pressure and local KV cache sizes? this was the subtle trigger.
marta: agreed — propose new playbook steps: 1) verify eviction metric > threshold 2) confirm KV cache config 3) fallback routing to smaller batch size 4) escalate to infra oncall if eviction rate > 5/min for 5m.

devon: writing actionable AIs now. short list: 
A1 - Add triage steps + commands to runtime/runbooks/redis-evictions.md (owner: devon) due: 2025-09-05
A2 - Add alert rule in observability for sustained evictions (>5/min for 5m) and link runbook (owner: marta) due: 2025-09-04
A3 - Add rollback/fallback snippet to routing playbook to reduce batch size and bypass cache (owner: chris) due: 2025-09-06
A4 - Postmortem analyst to tag other incidents with same pattern and create a recurring incident summary (owner: samir) due: 2025-09-07

samir: nice. make sure each AI has a PR template check and that the runbook includes exact shell commands + expected outputs for quick verification. also include a HYPOTHESIS section so oncall knows what to expect.
marta: will add PR checklist: docs/PR_CHECKLIST.md -> requires: hypothesis, commands, owners, rollback steps, smoke-test commands.

triage-bot: Suggestion: include a small post-trigger checklist for service owners:
- run `redis-cli INFO memory` -> expect maxmemory > used_memory
- run `kubectl logs` for pods with eviction events and copy the pod name into the incident ticket
- fallback: set header X-BATCH-SIZE=32 for affected route (temporary)

chris: flagging a recurring pattern: 3 incidents in last 30 days with similar KV cache misconfigs. we should include a short section in playbook: "known recurring causes" so triage is faster.

devon: I'll open the runbook PR today with the commands and the Known Causes section. PR will reference incident #4528 and include the AIs above.

samir: thanks — please add the PR link here once open. i'll follow up in next ops sync to verify closure. :thumbsup:

devon: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runbooks/pull/271 — includes triage cmds, hypothesis, and A1 mapping.
marta: created observability ticket: https://observability.redwood/tickets/823 for alert rule (A2).
samir: closing loop: we'll run a 2-week check to see if alerts fire and if the recurring-incident tag drops. thanks team.
